about: Pixel Pantry weight table. cup = grams per US cup (236.6 ml); each = grams per piece (sizes override by size word); units = grams per named unit; tbsp/tsp = grams per spoon when not cup/16 or cup/48; dens = g/ml for metric volumes; spice = never weighed. src: USDA (FoodData Central SR Legacy 2018-04 / FNDDS 2024-10, public domain), KA (King Arthur ingredient weight chart), est (a typical value).
